acceptanceCriteria: 未知 authority 被 start 拒绝且不会创建 active Contract 或 Summary。
合法 authorized 与 missing 值保持可创建 Work Item 的现有行为。

typed required verification declarations are planned as executable argv commands and recorded under the exact declared check identity; they do not silently fall back to repository-default verification.

an additive post-checkpoint amendment may invalidate a typed required check, but after a current non-red preflight the one fresh replacement verification is allowed to start; unrelated blocked controls still prevent subprocess execution.
goal: 未知 authority 在写入任何 active Contract/Summary 前被拒绝；合法 authority 保持现有行为，并有可重复回归测试。
intent: 修复 Runtime 在 start 时接受未知 authority 并制造不可继续 active Work Item 的确定性前检缺口。
outOfScope: 不改变授权语义、不修改发布流程、不删除或篡改既有 active/archived Work Item。

sources.reason: Defines the start transition that must reject invalid authority values before writing active Work Item state.
Exercises the start transition and its active-state boundary.
CLI selection and request-node identity path for Contract verification declarations
End-to-end CLI regression proving a typed required Contract check is planned under its declared identity.
Deterministic verification precondition that must permit fresh typed evidence after an additive Contract amendment.
